memories.content: The atlas release build repeatedly gets cancelled by CI (2026-08-11, 2026-08-19, 2026-09-01) because the pipeline kills any job running past 30 minutes, and every release build starts with an empty cargo registry cache (no persistent caching configured), which adds ~18 minutes of cold-compile overhead — pushing total build time over the 30-minute limit. Fix: configure persistent cargo registry caching (e.g. actions/cache keyed on Cargo.lock, or sccache) in the atlas release workflow so builds stay warm and finish under the timeout; raising the timeout is only a stopgap.
